champion.builds: THE BEST LEE SIN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Lee Sin Bot build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Demolish and Revitalize in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Eclipse as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Profane Hydra. For your last 3 items, you should build Death's Dance, Spirit Visage and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 68.8% winrate over 64 matches played. Situational Lee Sin Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Lee Sin build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Lee Sin runes page.
